items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Remember Bunny in there with us on the train that day and us killed him?

ctx.x: Yeah, Boost. Monroe Boost Club. Boost. He gave me and Ed five dollars a piece to put that sign on both sides of the coach. And so he said, well, y'all get ready to go. Mr. Williams, that's the one. Dr. Williams. He said, well, y'all go into town? I said, yeah, we're going to run up town. Other boys didn't know nothing about New Orleans, but I knew, you see. Sure. He said, we're going up to Ramport Street. Well, the coaches will be there. You won't have to come back up here and call them. They'll just go down to…
